cohort: N/A (This abstract provides an overview of Transposition of the Great Arteries, its diagnosis, and treatment, rather than describing a specific cohort studied by the authors.)
finding: The prenatal detection rate of TGA, especially simple TGA, is generally low (25-50%), but prenatal diagnosis improves postnatal outcomes and survival rates, with a 20-year survival rate of 90-97% following Arterial Switch Operation.
